extra_vocab.en: a fixed length of time, such as the length of a contract
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，a longer term 是「較長的合約期間」。男子認為只要簽比較久的合約，廠商可能願意降低費率。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 指合約「期間」時用單數（a three-year term）；指「條款、條件」時一定用複數 terms（the terms of the contract）。

example.en: The vendor agreed to change several terms of the service contract.
example.zh: 廠商同意更改服務合約的幾項條款。

example.en: We are looking for a long-term partner for this project.
example.zh: 我們在為這個專案尋找長期的合作夥伴。

example.en: A short-term contract gives us more flexibility.
example.zh: 短期合約讓我們更有彈性。

example.en: Please read the terms and conditions before you sign.
example.zh: 簽名前請先閱讀條款與條件。

example.en: In terms of price, this vendor is the best choice.
example.zh: 就價格而言，這家廠商是最佳選擇。

examples.en: The term of this agreement is two years.
examples.zh: 這份協議的期間是兩年。

examples.en: We should review the terms before we renew.
examples.zh: 續約之前，我們應該先檢視條款。

confusable.diff: team 是「團隊」，拼法和 term 只差一個字母，要小心看清楚。

example.en: The legal team will review the contract terms.
example.zh: 法務團隊會審查合約條款。

similar.diff: period 是一般的「一段期間」；term 特指合約、任期或學期等有固定長度的期間。

example.en: The trial period lasts for thirty days.
example.zh: 試用期為期三十天。

similar.diff: duration 較正式，指「持續多久」；term 強調有固定起訖的期限。

example.en: The duration of the service is twelve months.
example.zh: 這項服務的期間為十二個月。

example.en: The contract will expire at the end of June.
example.zh: 這份合約會在六月底到期。

example.en: The renewal notice was sent last week.
example.zh: 續約通知上週已寄出。

example.en: The duration of the training is three days.
example.zh: 訓練的時間為三天。

example.en: The term of the lease is three years.
example.zh: 租約的期間是三年。

senses.en: the rules and conditions of an agreement
senses.distinguish: 一定用複數 terms，常搭配 contract、agreement、payment。

example.en: The payment terms are thirty days from the invoice date.
example.zh: 付款條件是發票日起三十天。

senses.en: a word or phrase used for a special subject
senses.distinguish: 常和 technical、legal 連用，指專業術語。

example.en: Please explain this technical term to the client.
example.zh: 請向客戶說明這個技術術語。

extra_vocab.en: money you must pay when you break a rule or agreement
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，carry a penalty 是「附帶罰款」：男子請女子查看提早解約會不會被罰款或收違約金。這是續約或解約討論中很實際的問題。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 常用 penalty for + 名詞或 V-ing（a penalty for late payment）；「被罰」常說 pay a penalty、incur a penalty，或事情 carry a penalty。

example.en: Late deliveries may result in penalties under this agreement.
example.zh: 依據這份協議，延遲交貨可能會被處以罰款。

example.en: We had to pay a penalty for the late delivery.
example.zh: 我們必須為延遲交貨支付罰款。

example.en: A late penalty of five percent applies after the due date.
example.zh: 逾期後會加收百分之五的罰款。

example.en: The contract includes an early termination penalty of $2,000.
example.zh: 合約包含兩千美元的提前解約違約金。

example.en: You can cancel the booking without penalty before Friday.
example.zh: 星期五前取消預訂不會被罰。

examples.en: Breaking this agreement may result in a heavy penalty.
examples.zh: 違反這份協議可能會被處以重罰。

examples.en: Please note that late payments will incur a penalty.
examples.zh: 請注意，逾期付款會被收取罰款。

similar.diff: fine 常是政府或主管機關開出的「罰金」；penalty 範圍較廣，也包含合約中的違約金。

example.en: The company paid a fine for breaking the safety law.
example.zh: 公司因違反安全法規而繳了罰金。

similar.diff: surcharge 是「額外加收的費用」，不一定是處罰；penalty 帶有「違規被罰」的意思。

example.en: A fuel surcharge was added to the bill.
example.zh: 帳單上加收了燃料附加費。

example.en: A cancellation fee applies after the deadline.
example.zh: 截止日之後取消要收取取消費。

example.en: There is no charge for the first repair.
example.zh: 第一次維修免費。

example.en: The deposit will be returned after the contract ends.
example.zh: 訂金會在合約結束後退還。

derived.link: penal- 表示「處罰」，加 -ize 變動詞，像 organize、realize
